game.title: Ghostwire: Tokyo
game.blurb: First-person supernatural action-adventure in an emptied-out Shibuya, from Tango Gameworks, released 2022-03-24. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story chapters from beginning to end, with the hidden milestones and odd secrets. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Spirits and Side Missions
chapters.summary: Transferring the city's spirits, side missions, torii gates and Jizo statues.

chapters.title: Relics, Logs and Collections
chapters.summary: Relics, voice logs, magatama, landmarks, tanuki, food, music, outfits, talismans, prayer beads and katashiro.

chapters.title: Fighting the Visitors
chapters.summary: Ripping out cores, Quick Purge, the bow, talismans, Perfect Blocks, Wire In and every Visitor type.

chapters.title: Skills, Synergy and Meika
chapters.summary: Spirit Skills, synergy level and spending meika.

chapters.title: The Spider's Thread Update
chapters.summary: The achievements marked STU: new torii gates, skills, talismans and Visitors, capsule machines and "The Spider's Thread" mode.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages, but none of them exists, so nothing was used. ghostwiretokyo.fandom.com redirects "Ghostwire: Tokyo" to "GhostWire: Tokyo", with about 39 linked articles (places such as "Shibuya Scramble Crossing", "Shibuya Station", and characters "Akito", "KK", "Mari", "Rinko"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1475810 is the base game (1817250 is the separate Prelude). 18 of 66 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter. Seven of them ("Beginnings" to "Conclusions") read like story chapters; the others ("Animal Lover", "Amateur Photographer", "Lonely Tsukimi" and so on) are probably side secrets but the data does not say. Seven achievements start with "STU:" and talk about newly-added content and "The Spider's Thread" mode, so they have their own chapter; several base achievements say they exclude update content. The talisman combat feats (Stun, Thicket and Exposure Talismans) sit in the combat chapter.
